messages.subject: Just a thought...
messages.text:
Hello fine people of Lasclay !
 
 
 
 I am thinking that it would be great if there was a bulk milkweed Silk guideline amount ( obviously not for the batting ) 
 with the caveat that these are approximate ( according to artisans previous projects).
 

 IE: To make a duvet : 
 What amount one would need for a Twin
 Queen ( that is the one I am interested in…)
 & King size 
 

 And basic outdoor garments, such as "duvet vests" etc 
 I understand the reticence of divulging amounts for garments you sell but other than that… it might open a market. 
 

 Kudos for your great Company! 
 All the best in 2026
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Marie Dionne 
mariedionnephotography.com

messages.subject: Re: Just a thought...
messages.text:
Hi Marie,

That's a great suggestion, and honestly a fair one. We've been hesitant to publish those numbers because the silk behaves differently depending on how it's processed and what it's combined with, so we'd hate to give people inaccurate expectations. But a rough guideline with a clear "your results may vary" disclaimer? That makes sense, and you're right that it could open up a whole new market for the bulk silk.

I'm passing this along to our product team. I can't promise a timeline, but it's genuinely worth exploring.

Thanks for the kind words and for thinking of ways we can grow this together.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
